title: 第23章 推演第24章 内院
slug: 每日情报从打渔人开始武道通神
lines: 演武场上。
三十余号外院弟子排开阵势，然后依次在梅霜风面前演练『玄鹰桩』。
“重心太浮，重来！”
“下盘不稳，桩步犹如风中败絮，再练！”
“鹰爪无骨，软绵无力，去，举一个时辰青石锁！”
梅霜风双手负后，踏着满地残雪逐一巡视。
她面沉如水，训斥之声毫不留情，骂得不少弟子面红耳赤，噤若寒蝉。
直至行至沈修寒身前。
看他整套动作起落有致、下盘稳若黎山，十指起落间已有几分苍鹰搏兔的雏形。
梅霜风面容终于稍稍缓和，微不可察颔了颔首。
虽未曾出言嘉奖，只是稍作驻足便径直踱向下一人，但这般待遇，已经落入了场内有心人的眼中。
考校刚一结束，众人如蒙大赦，纷纷散去揉腿歇息。
这时，一阵淡淡的脂粉香风悄然飘至沈修寒身侧。
“沈师弟。”
来人一袭剪裁得体的绛红劲装，勾勒出窈窕的腰段，面容姣好，抱拳道：
“在下罗巧倩。”
沈修寒入门这些天，除了萧文外，和其他同门接触不多。
但对外院弟子的底细，了解的却并不少。
譬如眼前这位罗巧倩，乃是内城“罗家”的旁系子弟。
而罗家，与白、纪、韩、王四姓，并称为长云县的五大家族，可谓底蕴深厚。
沈修寒利落翻身跃下木桩，不卑不亢抱拳一礼：
“罗师姐。”
“师弟毋须多礼，我不过见猎心喜，与你闲叙几句罢了。”
罗巧倩笑意盈盈，眸光在他身上打了个转：
“方才考校，师父对沈师弟可是满意的紧呢，想来以师弟的进度，叩开血门、踏入内院，恐怕只是迟早的事了。”
“师姐言重了。”
沈修寒不动声色道：
“诸位师兄师姐修为皆领先于我，师弟不过是笨鸟先飞，当不起这般谬赞。”
“诶，师弟自谦了…”
罗巧倩娇声轻笑，莲步轻挪，凑近了半寸：
“我见师弟如此刻苦，实在难得。只是武道一途，素来讲究‘三分练，七分药’，若是一味干熬气血，只怕伤了自身根本…”
她顿了顿，美目直勾勾地锁着沈修寒的眼睛，吐气如兰：
“今晚，我在内城的‘醉仙楼’包了个清静的雅间，特意备了些‘气血药膳’，不知师弟可愿赏光一聚？”
content_en:
On the martial arts field.
More than thirty disciples from the outer courtyard formed a formation, and then practiced the "Xuanying Stake" in front of Mei Shuangfeng.
"The center of gravity is too floating, start over!"
"The lower body is unstable and the stance steps are like catkins blown by the wind. Practice again!"
"The eagle's claws are boneless and weak. Go ahead and lift an hour bluestone lock!"
"..."
Mei Shuangfeng put her hands behind her back and walked through the remaining snow on the ground to inspect one by one.
Her face was as dark as water, and her scolding voice was merciless, which made many disciples blush and become silent.
Until he arrived in front of Shen Xiuhan.
It can be seen that his whole set of movements rises and falls in a coordinated manner, his lower body is as stable as a mountain, and the rise and fall of his fingers already have the prototype of a goshawk fighting a rabbit.
Mei Shuangfeng's expression finally softened slightly, and she nodded imperceptibly.
Although he didn't say any words of praise, he just stopped for a moment and walked straight to the next person, but this kind of treatment has already fallen into the eyes of the caring people in the field.
As soon as the exams ended, everyone dispersed to rub their legs and rest as if they had been granted amnesty.
At this time, a faint fragrance of powder and powder quietly drifted to Shen Xiuhan's side.
"Junior Brother Shen."
The person who came was wearing a well-tailored crimson outfit that outlined a slim waist. He had a pretty face and cupped his fists and said:
"I'm Luo Qiaoqian."
Shen Xiuhan has not had much contact with other disciples except Xiao Wen during the past few days since he started.
But he didn't know much about the details of the disciples in the outer courtyard.
For example, the Luo Qiaoqian in front of her is a descendant of the "Luo family" in the inner city.
The Luo family, together with the four surnames Bai, Ji, Han, and Wang, are known as the five major families in Changyun County, and they have a profound heritage.
Shen Xiuhan turned over neatly and jumped off the wooden post, neither humble nor overbearing, cupped his fists and saluted:
"Senior Sister Luo."
"Junior brother, there is no need to be polite. I am just happy to see you, so I would like to chat with you for a few words."
Luo Qiaoqian smiled, and her eyes turned on him:
"I just took the exam, and Master is very satisfied with Junior Brother Shen. Considering Junior Brother's progress, it will only be a matter of time before he knocks on the Blood Gate and steps into the inner courtyard."
"Sister, you are serious."
Shen Xiuhan said calmly:
"All senior brothers and sisters are ahead of me in cultivation. Junior brother is just a stupid bird that flew first and cannot deserve such ridiculous praise."
"Hey, junior brother is so humble..."
Luo Qiaoqian chuckled softly, moved lightly, and came half an inch closer:
"It's really rare for me to see my junior brother working so hard. It's just that in the martial arts, we always pay attention to 'three points of training and seven points of medicine'. If you just boil the energy and blood, I'm afraid you will damage your own foundation..."
She paused, her beautiful eyes locked directly on Shen Xiuhan's, and she exhaled:
"Tonight, I booked a quiet and elegant room in the 'Zui Xian Tower' in the inner city, and specially prepared some 'Qi and Blood Medicinal Food'. I wonder if Junior Brother would be willing to come and enjoy it together?"
